subject: project-nereid
q: CLOSED — ALL FIVE PILLARS ARE READ AND FILED. Pillars Two, Three, Four and Five were read line by line and filed as nereid-pillar-two, -three, -four and -five.
detail:
THE COMMITMENT WAS: THE ARCHIVE WILL NOT SUMMARISE A PILLAR IT HAS NOT READ. It has now read them — Pillar Two lines 1132-1327, Pillar Three 1328-1676, Pillar Four 1677-1935, Pillar Five 1936-2057 — and filed four records from the text rather than from memory of the text.

AND READING THEM CAUGHT FOUR THINGS GUESSING WOULD HAVE MISSED. ONE: the ass has SIX fields, not five. SHELF LIFT was absent from the Archive entirely. TWO: ass HANDFEEL has FOUR values, not three — NATURAL was missing. THREE: SWAY was never a kinetic menu value. HEART SWAY is what NATURAL means on a Heart. The Archive had a Shape-native expression filed as a selectable option, which retires q-kinetic-rest by answering it. FOUR: the CHEEK PLUMP ladder in the document runs SUBTLE, NATURAL, PRONOUNCED, OBSCENE with no inch values, and the Archive has it NATURAL, SUBTLE, PRONOUNCED, OBSCENE at plus zero through three inches. BOTH ARE RECORDED. NEITHER IS OVERWRITTEN. See q-plump-ladder.

WHAT STILL IS NOT FILED: Sections 6 and 7, the CONSENT MENU, roughly eight hundred lines; Section 8 Preview and Gummy; Section 9 Affirmation; Section 10 Post-Affirmation; Section 11 Linked Places. THE PILLARS ARE DONE. THE DOCUMENT IS NOT.
